github.description: GitHub operations — read/write repos, create PRs, push files, manage issues. Also used by github-market-map and profile-intelligence skills for the GitHub REST API layer.

filesystem.description: Extended local filesystem access. Set CAREER_OS_ROOT in .env to your absolute repo path.

indeed.description: Indeed job search — live listings. Used by job-aggregator skill.

ziprecruiter.description: ZipRecruiter job search — authless, live listings. Used by job-aggregator skill.

dice.description: Dice job search — tech-focused, authless. Used by job-aggregator skill.

puppeteer.description: Headless browser — renders HTML to PDF for resume export. Used by pdf-export skill.

_removed.firecrawl: Removed. Claude's built-in WebSearch and WebFetch are the web layer for this project — always available, no key, no quota to exhaust. Firecrawl added a paid dependency and a second failure mode for no capability Career OS actually needed. If you want it back, add the server block and set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY; nothing depends on it.

_setup_notes.step1: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in your keys
_setup_notes.step2: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN required for github + market-map skills — free to create
_setup_notes.step3: No web-scraping key needed — Claude built-in WebSearch/WebFetch are the web layer
_setup_notes.step4: CAREER_OS_ROOT should be the absolute path to this repo, e.g. /Users/you/career-os
_setup_notes.naukri_note: Naukri has no MCP/API — handled via scripts/naukri-scraper.py, not this file. Enable in config/user.json
_setup_notes.linkedin_note: No free/legal LinkedIn-layer data source is wired in yet (Crustdata requires a paid plan). profile-intelligence currently runs on GitHub public data only. Swap in a LinkedIn-data provider later by editing skills/profile-intelligence/SKILL.md and adding its MCP or API here.
